summary: Supabase-migration retest of iteration 14's 3 critical fixes. All 37 tests in test_supabase_migration.py now PASS (100%, was 32/37). Confirmed: (1) POST /api/admissions/submit works AFTER a prior /api/auth/login — get_supabase() singleton bug is fixed via fresh-per-call anon + dedicated service-role client; (2) POST /api/upload/image returns a public https URL — bucket 'question-images' present and _ensure_bucket() idempotent; (3) POST /api/auth/signup succeeds back-to-back (3 signups in TestAdmissions/Auth flows post-login); (4) /api/auth/me returns 200 after login with no sign_out() polluting the client. Part 5 batch isolation now completes end-to-end: JEEM2027 student sees 1 class / 1 test / 1 announcement, NEX2028 student sees 0 of each. Bad batch code returns 400 with 'not recognised' on both /admissions/submit and /batches/by-code. Part 6 (question with option-image) saves options jsonb correctly and appears in /samples. All Zoom API-level flows (create/start/join/raise+lower-hand) pass. Frontend smoke: student login works, sidebar is correctly trimmed to Dashboard/My Classes/Live Classes.

Meeting create + SDK signature work; participants list is empty and delete-meeting silently fails. External Zoom app config change (not code).

integration_issues.issue: Sidebar is correctly trimmed (Dashboard / My Classes / Live Classes) but the Dashboard body still renders 'Quick Navigation' cards linking to PYQ Section, My Tests, Assigned Tests, Analytics, Bookmarks — those routes are deferred and will 404 when clicked. Either remove these cards or gate them behind the same feature flag as the sidebar items.

action_items: (minor) Remove or hide the deferred Quick-Nav cards on /dashboard (PYQ Section, My Tests, Assigned Tests, Analytics, Bookmarks) — they lead to 404 routes.

(external) Add Zoom S2S scopes user:read:token, dashboard:read:list_meeting_participants:admin, meeting:delete:meeting:admin in the Zoom App Marketplace to make teacher /participants and delete-meeting fully functional. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: get_supabase() / get_supabase_admin() split is clean — each call returns a fresh client so sign_in_with_password header mutation cannot leak. This is the right long-term fix.

upload_routes._ensure_bucket() is now best-effort and idempotent (ignores 'already exists') — good, but consider surfacing a startup log line so operators know whether the bucket was newly created or reused.

student_test_routes.submit() (unchanged carryover from iter14) still trusts client-supplied is_correct — a student can inflate score by posting is_correct:true for every answer. Server should verify against tests.questions.correct_answers.
notification_routes.list_notifications returns {notifications, unread_count} at top-level while every other endpoint wraps in {success: true, ...} — small consistency drift for the frontend.

success_rate.frontend: smoke: login + trimmed sidebar OK; deferred cards still visible on dashboard body

The 3 iter14 blockers (admission-after-login, upload bucket, signup regression) are resolved. Only remaining known issues are (a) Zoom S2S scopes — external config, and (b) dashboard body still shows deferred Quick-Nav cards even though the sidebar was trimmed. Safe to keep re-running the test file; idempotent.
rca of the issue: iter14 root causes were addressed as follows: (1) singleton supabase client → replaced with per-call factories get_supabase() (anon) and get_supabase_admin() (service role) so sign_in header mutation cannot poison admin ops; (2) missing bucket 'question-images' → created manually + _ensure_bucket() safe-idempotent; (3) /auth/me 401 after sign_out() → sign_out() removed and each login uses a fresh anon client. Verified by full-suite pass including the previously-failing tests test_admission_creates_user_and_roll, test_admission_me, test_nex2028_student_isolation, test_upload_image_returns_public_url, test_nex_student_does_not_see.
